# WildBoneWorkers

> Ethically sourced real animal skulls, skeleton articulation kits, taxidermy and natural history specimens. Free worldwide shipping with import duties covered. Checkout on Etsy and eBay.

## Collections
- [Real animal skulls](https://www.wildboneworkers.com/collections/skulls): Cleaned and whitened skulls, from fox, raccoon and nutria to a ram and an ostrich, plus collector sets of ten for altars and curiosity cabinets.
- [Skeletons & articulation kits](https://www.wildboneworkers.com/collections/skeletons): Complete skeletons from a single animal, cleaned and sorted by bone group, ready for your own articulation project. Plus display-ready pieces and fox paws.
- [Craft-grade bulk lots](https://www.wildboneworkers.com/collections/craft-grade): Real skulls with natural imperfections at a fraction of collector prices. Made for jewellery, resin casting, assemblage and altar work.
- [Taxidermy, insects & oddities](https://www.wildboneworkers.com/collections/oddities): Preserved ducklings, turtle shells, resin-cased arachnids, butterflies and marine curios for the cabinet that has everything else.

## Guides
- [How to articulate a skeleton kit](https://www.wildboneworkers.com/guides/articulating-a-skeleton-kit): Turning a box of sorted bones into a standing skeleton is slow, absorbing work. Here's how to approach your first articulation, step by step.
- [Caring for skulls & bone specimens](https://www.wildboneworkers.com/guides/bone-care): Properly prepared bone lasts for generations. A few simple habits keep your skulls and skeletons looking the way they did the day they arrived.
- [Collector grade vs craft grade skulls](https://www.wildboneworkers.com/guides/collector-vs-craft-grade): Both are real, cleaned bone. The difference is condition and price, and choosing the right one can halve what you spend on a project.
- [Gifts for oddity collectors](https://www.wildboneworkers.com/guides/gifts-for-oddity-collectors): Real skulls, skeletons and curios that make unforgettable gifts, grouped by budget. Every piece ships free worldwide with duties covered.
